transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, doctor. Well, I guess what brings me in is that I hardly eat right anymore. Some days... I don't know, it is just coffee and maybe a piece of bread for the whole day. I've lost weight, too. My pants are just hanging loose on me now. So, yeah, that's what's going on.
When you're eating so little, is it because you're afraid of gaining weight or want to be thinner, or is it more that you just don't feel hungry or interested in food?

No, it's not about wanting to be thin or anything like that. I just... I don't really have an appetite. Food just doesn't seem appealing, and I don't even think about eating most of the time. I just don't feel hungry.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you been feeling down, sad, or empty most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah, I have. It's... well, most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling right in my chest. It just feels like nothing good is waiting for me, so... I just want to keep my head down.
Did these feelings start around the same time as any particular stressful event or change in your life, like a loss, job change, or relationship issue?

No, not really. I mean... I've been out of work for a long time, so it's not a job thing. And there wasn't any big fight or someone dying or anything like that. It just... it just kind of crept up on me, I guess. Nothing specific really set it off.
How long have you been feeling this way—this heavy, empty mood and low appetite—would you say it's been going on for at least two weeks now?
Yeah, it's been a lot longer than two weeks. I think... well, this whole depressed spell has been hanging over me for about five months now. It just hasn't let up.
Have you ever had a similar period of low mood and loss of appetite like this before, at any point earlier in your life?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had bad days before, sure, but... nothing like this. This is the first time it's been this bad, where it just stays and stays. So, no, not before this.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself or that you'd be better off dead during this time?

No, I haven't. I mean, I feel really awful, but... no, I haven't thought about hurting myself or dying. I don't want to do anything like that. It's just been a really heavy feeling, but no thoughts of hurting myself.

How has this been affecting your ability to manage daily activities, like taking care of yourself, household tasks, or seeing other people—are you still able to do these things, even if it's harder, or have you found yourself unable to do them at all?

Well... honestly, it's gotten pretty bad. I can't really do much of anything right now. Since this heavy feeling set in, I've had to lean on my relatives for a lot. They've been helping me with money, giving me rides, and even sorting out my paperwork for me. I just... I'm not keeping up with basic errands or taking care of things the way I used to. It's just too much right now.
Have you experienced anything unusual lately, like hearing voices or sounds that others don't hear, or having thoughts or beliefs that others might find strange or hard to believe?

No, nothing like that. I don't hear voices or anything, and I don't think I have any weird beliefs. Just... just the heavy feeling and not being able to do anything. But my mind isn't playing tricks on me, if that's what you mean.
